commands.preboot: echo preboot...;if itest ${upgrade_step} == 1; then  defenv; setenv upgrade_step 2; saveenv;fi; secukey emmc; secukey updatehdcpkey;run initenv;switch_bootpart; modify_cmdline; run storeargs;if itest ${upgrade_step} == 3; then run update; fi; get_rebootmode; echo reboot_mode=${reboot_mode};run update_key; run init_display;run switch_bootmode;
commands.recovery: echo enter recovery...;hdcp prefetch emmc;store read recovery ${loadaddr} 0 800000; bootm
commands.update: echo update...; run usb_burning; run recovery;
commands.storeargs: setenv bootargs ${boot_args} vdaccfg=${vdac_config} storage=${store} logo=osd1,loaded,${fb_addr},${outputmode},full hdmimode=${hdmimode} cvbsmode=${cvbsmode} androidboot.firstboot=${firstboot} hdmitx=${cecconfig} val1=${sdioclk} sdhc_debug=0x00000200 rx_clk_phase=${rx_clk_phase} sd_clk_phase=${sd_clk_phase} androidboot.ubootversion=${ubootver}; saveenv
commands.update_key: echo update by key...; if monitor_bt_cmdline; then run recovery; fi;if irdetect; then run recovery; fi
commands.init_display: hdmi_det; logo size ${outputmode}; video dev open ${outputmode}; video open; video clear; imgread res logo ${loadaddr_logo}; unpackimg ${loadaddr_logo}; logo source ${outputmode}; bmp display ${bootup_offset};
commands.switch_bootmode: echo switch_bootmode...;if test ${reboot_mode} = normal; then else if test ${reboot_mode} = charging; then else if test ${reboot_mode} = factory_reset; then run recovery;else if test ${reboot_mode} = update; then run update;else if test ${reboot_mode} = usb_burning; then run usb_burning;else   fi;fi;fi;fi;fi
